_note: What you see: Admin settings (settings chrome): integrations catalogue (integration accounts such as shillinq, Tax Administration, pension fund, LMS), public API with keys, webhooks for HR lifecycle events, workflows (n8n), a marketplace of connectors, and read-only MCP access.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Admin settings (settings chrome): integrations catalogue (integration accounts such as shillinq, Belastingdienst, pension fund, LMS), public API with keys, webhooks for HR lifecycle events, workflows (n8n), marketplace of connectors, and MCP read-only access.
Welke systemen bij de HR-gegevens kunnen: Which systems can reach the HR data, for what, and when that was last reviewed.
journaalposten, betalingen en loonheffin: journal entries, payments and payroll tax
This list records who has access. The permissions themselves are in OpenRegister.
Lees en schrijf HR-gegevens vanuit ander: Read and write HR data from other systems.
Automatiseer HR-processen met stappen en: Automate HR processes with steps and approvals.
Nieuwe medewerker: account en toegangspa: New employee: request account and access pass
Verlof langer dan 10 dagen: tweede goedk: Leave longer than 10 days: second approval by HR
Laat een AI-hulpmiddel HR-gegevens doorz: Let an AI tool search HR data without being able to change anything.
Zoeken en lezen in vacatures, organisati: Search and read vacancies, organisation units, assets, timesheets and expense claims. There are no write actions.
Salaris, BSN, IBAN en verzuimgegevens zi: Salary, BSN, IBAN and absence data can never be read through MCP.
Stuur een bericht naar andere systemen a: Send a message to other systems when someone joins or leaves, changes job, takes leave or reports sick.
Elk bericht bevat niet meer persoonsgege: Each message holds no more personal data than the moment needs. Other Nextcloud apps get the same events.
Koppelingen van andere partijen, gecontr: Connections from other parties, checked by Conduction.
UPA-aangifte voor medewerkers in zorg en: UPA return for employees in healthcare and welfare.
Afstanden en vergoeding uit de reisplann: Distances and allowance from the journey planner.
Exchange sick reports and consultation hours.
